The epitope of chA21 scFv on the p185(her2/neu) N-terminal region (EPI) was determined from the crystal structure of the complex, solved by molecular replacement. There are two EPI and two scFv molecules in the asymmetric unit. Among the four molecules in the asymmetric unit, Chains A and C form one antigen-antibody complex, whereas Chains B and D form another. These two complexes are disposed in the asymmetric unit through a non-crystallographic two-fold rotation symmetry axis, and their structures are almost identical. Therefore, only the complex structure comprising Chains A and C, which has better electron density, is curated here.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.45 angstroms

The epitope-specific chA21 mAb bound to p185(her2/neu) on the surface of the human mammary cancer cell line SK-BR-3 and down-regulated expression of  p185(her2/neu). The scFv chA21 did not down-regulate p185(her2/neu), indicating the requirement for bivalency. MAb chA21 also down-regulated expression of  EGFR and ErbB3, which form heterodimers with p185(her2/neu). MAb chA21 was also shown to form high molecular weight complexes with a p185(her2/neu) ectodomain-human Fc fusion protein.
